description: Rent a canoe, complete the waiver, pay the required fees, and collect the necessary equipment.

dialogue.en: Hi! We’d like to rent a canoe.
dialogue.zh: 你好！我们想租一艘独木舟。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Of course! How long would you like to rent it for?
dialogue.zh: 当然可以！你们想租多长时间？
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: Two hours, please.
dialogue.zh: 两个小时，谢谢。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: I’ll just need you to fill out this waiver.
dialogue.zh: 没问题。你们只需要填写一下这份免责协议。
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: The rental fee is $28. There’s also a $50 security deposit.
dialogue.zh: 租金是28加元，另外还需要支付50加元的押金。
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: No problem. I’ll pay by card.
dialogue.zh: 没问题，我刷卡支付。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Here’s your safety kit. Please keep it in the canoe at all times and choose a life jacket that fits you.
dialogue.zh: 这是你们的安全装备。请全程把它放在独木舟里，并选择一件尺寸合适的救生衣。
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: Okay. This one fits well.
dialogue.zh: 好的，这件很合适。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Here’s your canoe, and here are your paddles. Have fun!
dialogue.zh: 这是你们的独木舟，这些是船桨。玩得开心！
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: Thank you!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！
dialogue.speaker: Customer

tips.body: Before renting a canoe, you may need to sign a waiver confirming that you understand the risks.
tips.title: Tip 1
tips.bodyZh: 租独木舟之前，通常需要签署免责协议，确认自己了解相关风险。

tips.body: A security deposit may be temporarily charged to your card and refunded after the canoe is returned without damage.
tips.title: Tip 2
tips.bodyZh: 商家可能会暂时收取押金。独木舟完好归还后，押金通常会退回。

description: Ask for the right size, try on the clothes, and complete your purchase.

dialogue.en: Excuse me. Do you have this in a small?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，这件有小号吗？
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Let me check. Yes, we do. Here you go.
dialogue.zh: 我帮您查一下。有的，给您。
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: Perfect. Thank you!
dialogue.zh: 太好了，谢谢！
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Where are the fitting rooms?
dialogue.zh: 请问试衣间在哪里？
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: They’re right over there.
dialogue.zh: 就在那边。
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: How did everything fit?
dialogue.zh: 这些衣服穿着都合适吗？
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: Great! I’ll take these two.
dialogue.zh: 很合适！这两件我要了。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Your total is $78.45.
dialogue.zh: 一共是78.45加元。
dialogue.speaker: Cashier

dialogue.en: Credit, please.
dialogue.zh: 刷信用卡，谢谢。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Perfect. All set. Have a great day!
dialogue.zh: 好的，已经好了。祝您今天愉快！
dialogue.speaker: Cashier

dialogue.en: You too!
dialogue.zh: 您也是！
dialogue.speaker: Customer

tips.body: In Canada, clothing sizes may be shown as XS, S, M, L and XL, or as numbers.
tips.title: Tip 1
tips.bodyZh: 在加拿大，衣服尺码通常使用XS、S、M、L、XL，也可能使用数字尺码。

tips.body: At checkout, Canadians often say “Credit, please” or “I’ll pay by credit.”
tips.title: Tip 2
tips.bodyZh: 结账时，加拿大人经常说“Credit, please”或“I’ll pay by credit”。

subtitle_cues.en: Do you have this in a small?

subtitle_cues.zh: 这些衣服穿着都合适吗？

title_zh: 邮寄护照至 IRCC 贴签
description: Mail your passport to IRCC for visa stamping.

dialogue.en: Hi, I’d like to mail my passport to IRCC for visa stamping.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想把护照寄给 IRCC 办理贴签。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Sure. I can help you with that.
dialogue.zh: 当然可以。
dialogue.speaker: Clerk

dialogue.en: I need one medium Xpresspost envelope and one small prepaid Xpresspost envelope for the return.
dialogue.zh: 我需要一个中号 Xpresspost 信封，以及一个小号预付邮资的回邮信封。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: No problem.
dialogue.zh: 没问题。
dialogue.speaker: Clerk

dialogue.en: Put your passport and documents in the medium envelope, and place the prepaid return envelope inside.
dialogue.zh: 把护照和文件放进中号信封，再把预付邮资的回邮信封放进去。
dialogue.speaker: Clerk

dialogue.en: Okay. Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 好的，谢谢。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Would you like tracking?
dialogue.zh: 需要追踪服务吗？
dialogue.speaker: Clerk

dialogue.en: Yes, please.
dialogue.zh: 好的，谢谢。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Here’s your receipt and tracking number.
dialogue.zh: 这是您的收据和追踪号码。
dialogue.speaker: Clerk

tips.body: Keep the receipt and tracking number until IRCC returns your passport.
tips.title: Tip 1
tips.bodyZh: 在 IRCC 寄回护照之前，请妥善保管收据和追踪号码。

tips.body: Write your return address on the prepaid return envelope before placing it inside the mailing envelope.
tips.title: Tip 2
tips.bodyZh: 将回邮信封放入寄件信封前，记得先填写好回邮地址。

description: Understand the dental filling process, from protective glasses and local anesthetic to bite checking and aftercare.

dialogue.en: I’m going to give you some protective glasses.
dialogue.zh: 我给您一副防护眼镜。
dialogue.speaker: Dentist

dialogue.en: Okay, thank you.
dialogue.zh: 好的，谢谢。
dialogue.speaker: Patient

dialogue.en: They’ll protect your eyes from the bright light.
dialogue.zh: 它们可以保护您的眼睛不受强光刺激。
dialogue.speaker: Dentist

dialogue.en: I’m going to numb the area first.
dialogue.zh: 我先给这个部位打麻药。
dialogue.speaker: Dentist

dialogue.en: Will I feel anything?
dialogue.zh: 我会有感觉吗？
dialogue.speaker: Patient

dialogue.en: You’ll feel a little pinch, and then it should start to feel numb.
dialogue.zh: 您会感觉轻轻扎一下，然后这里会开始变麻。
dialogue.speaker: Dentist

dialogue.en: Does this feel numb?
dialogue.zh: 这里感觉麻了吗？
dialogue.speaker: Dentist

dialogue.en: Yes, my lip feels numb too.
dialogue.zh: 是的，我的嘴唇也感觉麻了。
dialogue.speaker: Patient

dialogue.en: That’s normal.
dialogue.zh: 这是正常的。
dialogue.speaker: Dentist

dialogue.en: I’m going to remove the decay and place the filling now.
dialogue.zh: 现在我要清理蛀坏的部分并放入补牙材料。
dialogue.speaker: Dentist

dialogue.en: You’ll feel some pressure and vibration, but it shouldn’t hurt.
dialogue.zh: 您会感觉到一些压力和震动，但应该不会疼。
dialogue.speaker: Dentist

dialogue.en: Bite down and grind left and right.
dialogue.zh: 咬紧一点，然后左右磨动牙齿。
dialogue.speaker: Dentist

dialogue.en: Great.
dialogue.zh: 很好。
dialogue.speaker: Dentist

tips.body: Try not to chew until the numbness wears off, so you don’t accidentally bite your lip or the inside of your cheek.
tips.title: Tip 1
tips.bodyZh: 麻药消退前尽量不要咀嚼，以免不小心咬伤嘴唇或脸颊内侧。

tips.body: If your bite feels high or uncomfortable after the filling, contact the dental office for an adjustment.
tips.title: Tip 2
tips.bodyZh: 如果补牙后感觉咬合偏高或不舒服，请联系牙科诊所进行调磨。

subtitle_cues.en: I’m going to give you some protective glasses.
They’ll protect your eyes from the bright light.
subtitle_cues.zh: 它们可以保护您的眼睛不受强光刺激。

subtitle_cues.en: I’m going to numb the area first.
subtitle_cues.zh: 我先给这个部位打麻药。

subtitle_cues.en: You’ll feel a little pinch, and then it should start to feel numb.
subtitle_cues.zh: 您会感觉轻轻扎一下，然后这里会开始变麻。

subtitle_cues.en: Yes, my lip feels numb too.
subtitle_cues.zh: 是的，我的嘴唇也感觉麻了。

subtitle_cues.en: Let me know if you feel any pain.
I’m going to remove the decay and place the filling now.
subtitle_cues.zh: 现在我要清理蛀坏的部分并放入补牙材料。

subtitle_cues.en: You’ll feel some pressure and vibration, but it shouldn’t hurt.
subtitle_cues.zh: 您会感觉到一些压力和震动，但应该不会疼。

subtitle_cues.en: Bite down and grind left and right.
subtitle_cues.zh: 咬紧一点，然后左右磨动牙齿。

subtitle_cues.en: The anesthetic will wear off in a few hours.
subtitle_cues.zh: 麻药会在几个小时后消退。

description: Complete intraoral and panoramic dental X-rays.

dialogue.en: Hi, I’m going to take a few X-rays of your teeth today.
dialogue.zh: 您好，今天我要给您的牙齿拍几张 X 光片。
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: I’m going to place this small sensor inside your mouth. Please bite down gently.
dialogue.zh: 我要把这个小传感器放进您的嘴里。请轻轻咬住。
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: Like this?
dialogue.zh: 像这样吗？
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: This feels a little sharp on the side.
dialogue.zh: 侧面感觉有点硌。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: I’m sorry. Let me adjust it for you.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我帮您调整一下。
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: Now we’re going to take a panoramic X-ray. Please place your chin here and bite down on this plastic piece.
dialogue.zh: 现在我们要拍一张全景 X 光片。请把下巴放在这里，并咬住这个塑料咬合块。
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: Please keep your tongue against the roof of your mouth and stay very still. The machine will rotate around your head.
dialogue.zh: 请让舌头贴住上颚，并保持不动。机器会绕着您的头部旋转。
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: Perfect. We’re all done.
dialogue.zh: 很好。全部完成了。
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

tips.body: The small sensor used for intraoral X-rays may feel uncomfortable. Tell the dental assistant if it feels sharp or painful.
tips.title: Tip 1
tips.bodyZh: 拍口内 X 光时，小传感器可能会让人感到不舒服。如果觉得硌或疼，可以告诉牙科助理。

tips.body: During a panoramic X-ray, keeping your tongue against the roof of your mouth helps produce a clearer image.
tips.title: Tip 2
tips.bodyZh: 拍全景 X 光时，让舌头贴住上颚有助于获得更清晰的影像。

description: Use your Plum membership and complete your purchase at checkout.

dialogue.en: Hi! Did you find everything you were looking for today?
dialogue.zh: 您好！今天想找的东西都找到了吗？
dialogue.speaker: Cashier

dialogue.en: Yes, I did. Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 是的，都找到了。谢谢。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Do you have a Plum membership?
dialogue.zh: 您有 Plum 会员吗？
dialogue.speaker: Cashier

dialogue.en: Yes, I do.
dialogue.zh: 有的。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Could I have your phone number, please?
dialogue.zh: 可以告诉我您的电话号码吗？
dialogue.speaker: Cashier

dialogue.en: Your total comes to $42.75.
dialogue.zh: 一共是 42.75 加元。
dialogue.speaker: Cashier

dialogue.en: I'll pay by card.
dialogue.zh: 我刷卡。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: You can tap whenever you're ready.
dialogue.zh: 准备好后就可以感应付款。
dialogue.speaker: Cashier

dialogue.en: Would you like your receipt by email or on paper?
dialogue.zh: 您想要电子邮件收据还是纸质收据？
dialogue.speaker: Cashier

dialogue.en: Paper is fine, thank you.
dialogue.zh: 纸质的就可以，谢谢。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Here you go. Have a wonderful day!
dialogue.zh: 给您。祝您今天愉快！
dialogue.speaker: Cashier

dialogue.en: Thank you. You too!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。您也是！
dialogue.speaker: Customer

expressions.en: find everything you were looking for
expressions.label: find everything you were looking for

expressions.zh: 准备好后即可感应付款
expressions.label: tap whenever you're ready

expressions.en: receipt by email or on paper
expressions.zh: 电子邮件收据或纸质收据
expressions.label: receipt by email or on paper

tips.body: At Indigo, the cashier may ask whether you have a Plum membership before payment.
tips.title: Tip 1
tips.bodyZh: 在 Indigo 结账时，收银员可能会在付款前询问您是否有 Plum 会员。

tips.body: Many stores can look up your membership using the phone number linked to your account.
tips.title: Tip 2
tips.bodyZh: 许多商店可以通过会员账户绑定的电话号码查询您的会员信息。

title_en: Inviting a Child to a Birthday Party
title_zh: 邀请孩子参加生日派对
description: Invite a child to a birthday party, explain the water activities, and check for food allergies.

dialogue.en: Hey, we’re having a birthday party for Leo next Saturday. We’d love for Ethan to come.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我们下周六要给 Leo 举办生日派对。我们很希望 Ethan 能来参加。
dialogue.speaker: Parent A

dialogue.en: Oh, that sounds great. I’m sure he’d love to come.
dialogue.zh: 听起来太棒了。我相信他一定很想去。
dialogue.speaker: Parent B

dialogue.en: We’re renting a big inflatable water slide for the kids, so they’ll be playing with water.
dialogue.zh: 我们会给孩子们租一个大型充气水滑梯，所以他们会玩水。
dialogue.speaker: Parent A

dialogue.en: That sounds like so much fun!
dialogue.zh: 听起来一定特别好玩！
dialogue.speaker: Parent B

dialogue.en: Could you have him bring his swimsuit, a water gun, and a towel?
dialogue.zh: 你可以让他带上泳衣、水枪和浴巾吗？
dialogue.speaker: Parent A

dialogue.en: Sure, no problem. I’ll pack those for him.
dialogue.zh: 当然，没问题。我会给他准备好的。
dialogue.speaker: Parent B

dialogue.en: Also, does he have any food allergies or anything else we should know about?
dialogue.zh: 另外，他有没有食物过敏，或者还有什么情况是我们需要提前知道的？
dialogue.speaker: Parent A

dialogue.en: No, he doesn’t have any allergies.
dialogue.zh: 没有，他没有任何过敏。
dialogue.speaker: Parent B

dialogue.en: Perfect. I’ll send you the address and all the party details.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我会把地址和派对的详细信息发给你。
dialogue.speaker: Parent A

dialogue.en: Great. Thanks so much for inviting him.
dialogue.zh: 好的。非常感谢你邀请他。
dialogue.speaker: Parent B

dialogue.en: Of course! We’re excited to have him.
dialogue.zh: 不客气！我们很期待他来参加。
dialogue.speaker: Parent A

dialogue.en: We’re looking forward to it.
dialogue.zh: 我们也很期待。
dialogue.speaker: Parent B

dialogue.en: See you next Saturday!
dialogue.zh: 下周六见！
dialogue.speaker: Parent A

expressions.en: We’d love for him to come.
expressions.label: We’d love for him to come.

expressions.en: bring a swimsuit and a towel
expressions.label: bring a swimsuit and a towel

expressions.zh: 帮他把那些东西准备好
expressions.label: pack those for him

expressions.en: anything else we should know about
expressions.zh: 其他我们需要提前知道的情况
expressions.label: anything else we should know about

tips.body: For water activities, parents often mention exactly what children should bring, such as a swimsuit, towel, or water shoes.
tips.title: Tip 1
tips.bodyZh: 如果派对有玩水活动，家长通常会明确说明孩子需要携带泳衣、浴巾或水鞋等物品。

tips.body: Always tell the host about food allergies, dietary restrictions, medical needs, or anything else relevant to the child’s safety.
tips.title: Tip 2
tips.bodyZh: 如果孩子有食物过敏、饮食限制、医疗需求或其他安全相关情况，应提前告诉主办方。

description: Order dishes to share, respond to the server, and pack up the leftovers.

dialogue.en: Hi! Are you ready to order?
dialogue.zh: 您好！准备好点餐了吗？
dialogue.speaker: Server

dialogue.en: Yes. We’ll start with the eggplant in tomato sauce.
dialogue.zh: 准备好了。我们先点茄子番茄酱。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: We’ll have one order of lamb chops, one order of chicken wings, and one order of beef shish.
dialogue.zh: 我们要一份羊排、一份鸡翅和一份牛肉串。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Great. Anything to drink?
dialogue.zh: 好的。需要喝点什么吗？
dialogue.speaker: Server

dialogue.en: Three Cokes, please.
dialogue.zh: 请给我们三杯可乐。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Here’s some Turkish bread with cacık and spicy ezme for the table.
dialogue.zh: 这是给全桌一起享用的土耳其面包、酸奶黄瓜酱和辣味 ezme。
dialogue.speaker: Server

dialogue.en: Here are the main courses. Are you sharing everything, or is each person having their own dish?
dialogue.zh: 主菜来了。你们是一起分享，还是每人吃自己的菜？
dialogue.speaker: Server

dialogue.en: We’re sharing everything.
dialogue.zh: 我们一起分享。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: No problem. I’ll bring you some extra plates.
dialogue.zh: 没问题。我给你们拿几个额外的盘子。
dialogue.speaker: Server

dialogue.en: How was everything?
dialogue.zh: 餐点怎么样？
dialogue.speaker: Server

dialogue.en: It was delicious. The portions were really generous.
dialogue.zh: 非常好吃，而且分量很足。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: We still have quite a bit left. Could we get two takeout boxes, please?
dialogue.zh: 我们还剩下不少。可以给我们两个打包盒吗？
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Of course. I’ll bring them right over.
dialogue.zh: 当然。我马上拿过来。
dialogue.speaker: Server

tips.body: At many Turkish restaurants, bread and small dips may be served for the whole table to share.
tips.title: Tip 1
tips.bodyZh: 在很多土耳其餐厅，面包和小份蘸酱会作为全桌共享的配套食物上桌。

tips.body: “Takeout box” is common in Canada; “to-go box” is also widely understood.
tips.title: Tip 2
tips.bodyZh: 在加拿大常说 takeout box，to-go box 也很常见。

title_en: Requesting a Price Adjustment at Costco
title_zh: 在 Costco 申请退差价
description: Ask Costco for a price adjustment after an item goes on sale.

dialogue.en: Hi, I bought a lunch bag here last week, and I noticed it's on sale now. I was wondering if I could get a price adjustment?
dialogue.zh: 你好！我上周在这里买了一个午餐包，今天发现它降价了。我想问一下，可以退差价吗？
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Of course, do you have your receipt?
dialogue.zh: 当然可以。请问有购物小票吗？
dialogue.speaker: Clerk

dialogue.en: Not with me, but I think I can find it in the Costco app.
dialogue.zh: 我现在没带，不过我可以在 Costco App 里找一下。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: No worries. I can also look it up using your membership card.
dialogue.zh: 没关系。我也可以通过你的会员卡帮你查。
dialogue.speaker: Clerk

dialogue.en: I'm all set. The refund has been processed.
dialogue.zh: 好了，已经处理完成了。我会把差价退回到你原来的付款方式。
dialogue.speaker: Clerk

dialogue.en: Thank you so much.
dialogue.zh: 太感谢了！
dialogue.speaker: Customer

tips.body: Many Canadian stores offer a price adjustment if an item goes on sale shortly after you buy it.
tips.title: Tip 1
tips.bodyZh: 加拿大很多商家都提供退差价的服务，如果商品购买后短时间内降价，可以申请退还差价。

tips.body: Always keep your receipt or digital order history.
tips.title: Tip 2
tips.bodyZh: 记得保留购物小票或电子订单记录。

title_en: Picking Up a Mobile Order at Tim Hortons
title_zh: 在 Tim Hortons 取手机订单
description: Pick up a mobile order at the drive-thru.

dialogue.en: Hi, welcome to Tim Hortons. What can I get for you?
dialogue.zh: 您好，欢迎来到 Tim Hortons。请问您想点什么？
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: Hi, I'm picking up a mobile order. The order number is 9118.
dialogue.zh: 您好，我来取手机订单。订单号是 9118。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Okay, let me check. Is that a latte, a wrap, and a six-pack of donuts?
dialogue.zh: 好的，我查一下。是一杯拿铁、一个卷饼，还有一盒六个甜甜圈，对吗？
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: Okay, that's right.
dialogue.zh: 对，没错。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Please drive up to the window.
dialogue.zh: 请开到前面的取餐窗口。
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: Hi. Here is your latte and your wrap.
dialogue.zh: 您好，这是您的拿铁和卷饼。
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: Thank you. I should have donuts too, right?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我还应该有甜甜圈，对吗？
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Oh, I'm so sorry. I'll grab those for you right now.
dialogue.zh: 真抱歉，我马上给您拿。
dialogue.speaker: Staff

tips.body: Many Canadian drive-thrus ask for your mobile order number before preparing your order.
tips.title: Tip 1
tips.bodyZh: 加拿大很多得来速会在准备订单前询问您的手机订单号。

tips.body: Before driving away, it's always a good idea to quickly check that everything is included.
tips.title: Tip 2
tips.bodyZh: 离开前，最好快速检查一下商品是否齐全。

title_zh: 致电 RBC 预约开户
description: Book an appointment to learn about opening your first RBC account and ask about a current promotion.

dialogue.en: Good morning, RBC. How can I help you today?
dialogue.zh: 早上好，这里是 RBC。今天有什么可以帮您？
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: Hi. I’d like to book an appointment to learn about opening a new bank account.
dialogue.zh: 您好，我想预约咨询一下开设新银行账户。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Of course.
dialogue.zh: 当然可以。
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: I also heard about the iPad offer, and I’d like to learn more about it.
dialogue.zh: 我还听说有 iPad 优惠，想进一步了解一下。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Sure. We can book you an appointment with an advisor.
dialogue.zh: 好的。我们可以为您预约一位顾问。
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: That would be great.
dialogue.zh: 那太好了。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Do you currently have an RBC account?
dialogue.zh: 您目前有 RBC 账户吗？
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: No, I don’t. This would be my first account with RBC.
dialogue.zh: 没有。这会是我在 RBC 开设的第一个账户。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: That’s fine.
dialogue.zh: 没问题。
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: I’d like to visit the Barrhaven branch. Do you have anything available this Friday afternoon?
dialogue.zh: 我想去 Barrhaven 分行。请问这周五下午有空余时间吗？
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Yes. We have an opening at 2:30 p.m. You’re booked for Friday at 2:30.
dialogue.zh: 有的。下午 2:30 有空位，已为您预约周五下午 2:30。
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: That works for me. Is there anything I should bring?
dialogue.zh: 这个时间可以。请问我需要携带什么？
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Please bring your photo ID. The advisor will go over the account options and promotion details with you.
dialogue.zh: 请携带带照片的身份证件。顾问会向您介绍账户选择和优惠详情。
dialogue.speaker: Staff

expressions.zh: 我在 RBC 的第一个账户
expressions.label: my first account with RBC

expressions.zh: 下午 2:30 的空余预约时段
expressions.label: an opening at 2:30 p.m.

tips.body: Bank promotions may have eligibility requirements and can change. Ask the advisor to explain the current terms before opening the account.
tips.title: Tip 1
tips.bodyZh: 银行优惠可能有资格条件，而且会发生变化。开户前可以请顾问说明当前的具体条款。

tips.body: Bring valid photo ID to your appointment and ask the branch whether any additional documents are required.
tips.title: Tip 2
tips.bodyZh: 预约当天请携带有效的带照片身份证件，也可以提前询问分行是否需要其他材料。

title_en: Checking In at a Family Doctor's Office
description: Check in for a doctor's appointment.

dialogue.en: Hi! How can I help you today?
dialogue.zh: 您好，请问有什么可以帮您？
dialogue.speaker: Receptionist

dialogue.en: Hi, I have an appointment with Dr. Smith.
dialogue.zh: 您好，我预约了 Smith 医生。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: May I have your health card, please?
dialogue.zh: 可以看一下您的健康卡吗？
dialogue.speaker: Receptionist

dialogue.en: Sure. (Hands over the health card.)
dialogue.zh: 当然。（递上健康卡。）
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Let me check you in.
dialogue.zh: 我来帮您签到。
dialogue.speaker: Receptionist

dialogue.en: You're all checked in.
dialogue.zh: 已经帮您签到好了。
dialogue.speaker: Receptionist

dialogue.en: Please have a seat. The doctor will call you shortly.
dialogue.zh: 请坐着等候，医生很快会叫您。
dialogue.speaker: Receptionist

dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

tips.body: Many family doctor's offices ask to see your health card at every visit, even if you've been there before.
tips.title: Tip 1
tips.bodyZh: 很多家庭医生诊所每次就诊都会查看您的健康卡，即使您以前来过。

tips.body: Try to arrive about 10–15 minutes early for your appointment.
tips.title: Tip 2
tips.bodyZh: 建议比预约时间提前约 10–15 分钟到达诊所。

title_en: Parent-Teacher Conference: Supporting a Child's Progress
title_zh: 家长会：了解孩子的问题并提供支持
description: Discuss a child's academic progress, identify areas that need support, and agree on practical next steps.

dialogue.en: Hi, thanks for coming in today.
dialogue.zh: 你好，谢谢你今天过来。
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.en: Of course. Thanks for meeting with me.
dialogue.zh: 应该的，也谢谢你抽时间和我见面。
dialogue.speaker: Parent

dialogue.en: Overall, Ethan is doing okay. He’s a kind and respectful student, and he gets along well with his classmates.
dialogue.zh: 总体来说，Ethan 表现还可以。他是一个友善、懂礼貌的学生，和同学们也相处得很好。
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.en: How is he doing academically?
dialogue.zh: 那他学习方面表现得怎么样？
dialogue.speaker: Parent

dialogue.en: He’s meeting some of the grade-level expectations, but there are a few areas where he needs more support.
dialogue.zh: 他达到了部分年级要求，不过还有几个方面需要更多帮助。
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.en: He can read the words, but sometimes he has trouble explaining what the story is about.
dialogue.zh: 他能把文字读出来，但有时候很难解释这个故事主要讲了什么。
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.en: I’ve also noticed that he sometimes loses focus during independent work.
dialogue.zh: 我还注意到，他在独立完成任务时有时会走神。
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.en: Do you think he’s falling behind?
dialogue.zh: 你觉得他现在落后了吗？
dialogue.speaker: Parent

dialogue.en: I wouldn’t say he’s falling significantly behind, but he would benefit from some extra practice.
dialogue.zh: 我不会说他已经明显落后，但增加一些额外练习会对他有帮助。
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.en: What can we do at home to help him?
dialogue.zh: 我们在家可以做些什么来帮助他？
dialogue.speaker: Parent

dialogue.en: Reading together for fifteen to twenty minutes each day would be helpful.
dialogue.zh: 每天一起阅读十五到二十分钟会很有帮助。
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.en: How can we keep track of his progress?
dialogue.zh: 我们之后可以怎样了解他的进步情况呢？
dialogue.speaker: Parent

dialogue.en: Let’s give it a few weeks, and I can send you an update by email.
dialogue.zh: 我们先观察几周，到时候我可以通过邮件向你更新情况。
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

tips.body: Teachers usually start by highlighting a child’s strengths before gently explaining the areas that need improvement.
tips.title: Tip 1
tips.bodyZh: 老师通常会先肯定孩子的优点，再委婉地说明需要改进的地方。

tips.body: Ask for specific examples and practical next steps instead of responding only with “Okay” or “Thank you.”
tips.title: Tip 2
tips.bodyZh: 不要只回应“好的”或“谢谢”，可以继续询问具体表现和可执行的改进方法。
